item.title: Amazon saves millions by replacing Sonnet 4.6 with Strands Decider
item.description: Two Amazon engineers swapped Claude Sonnet 4.6 for a decision model in one of the world's biggest internal ticketing systems.

item.title: Introducing Harness Optimizer: Automatically optimize your agent harness
item.description: Harness Optimizer is an open-source library that optimizes the context around your LLM agent (system prompt, tool docs, skills) the way you'd train a model: rollouts in, rewards out, parameters updated.
